financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 5,750,000 shares at $30.00 per share, including over-allotment, closed April 3, 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds to the Company from the offering were approximately $161.8 million, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and offering costs of approximately $11.0 million.
